title: Code for: Mechanistic equivalence and measurement design in models of bacterial nitrogen signaling
description: Reproducible code, published-data records, figures and manuscript sources for Mechanistic equivalence and measurement design in models of bacterial nitrogen signaling. Version 1.3.3 completes submission preparation with a concise initial-submission cover letter centered on the observation-conditioned guarantee and end-to-end binding benchmark. It retains the v1.3.2 GlnD comparison, assay-range and Fig5C corrections and the v1.3.1 verification fixes. The fitted predictions and figures are unchanged. No new experimental measurements were generated. Native-assay applications remain conditional on the stated observation, biochemical and calibration assumptions. Original code is MIT licensed; the retained Gosztolai et al. workbook and model retain their CC BY 4.0 attribution. Primary literature PDFs are not redistributed.
